general.hello: Hello! How can I help you with your career, interview preparation, or job search?
general.python: Python is a high-level programming language widely used for web development, data analysis, machine learning, automation, and artificial intelligence.
general.mern: MERN is a JavaScript-based full-stack technology stack consisting of MongoDB, Express.js, React, and Node.js.
general.resume: A resume is a document that summarizes your education, skills, projects, experience, and achievements for job applications.

career.developer: To build a software development career, focus on programming fundamentals, data structures and algorithms, databases, APIs, Git, and one or more development technologies. Building real projects is also important.
career.frontend: For frontend development, learn HTML, CSS, JavaScript, responsive design, Git, and a framework such as React.
career.backend: For backend development, learn a programming language, databases, REST APIs, authentication, server-side development, Git, and deployment.
career.fullstack: For full-stack development, learn both frontend and backend development along with databases, APIs, authentication, Git, and deployment.

interview.technical: For a technical interview, prepare programming fundamentals, data structures and algorithms, OOP, databases, APIs, Git, and questions related to your projects.
interview.hr: For an HR interview, prepare a clear self-introduction, your strengths and areas for improvement, your project experience, career goals, and common behavioral questions.
interview.project: Be ready to explain your project clearly, including the problem it solves, technologies used, your contribution, database design, important features, challenges, and how you solved them.

job.search: Our platform provides job opportunities for job seekers. Please sign in or register to view available positions and apply.
job.internship: For internships, look for opportunities on job portals, company career pages, LinkedIn, and through college networks. A portfolio with practical projects can help demonstrate your skills.
job.fresher: As a fresher, focus on building practical projects, maintaining a good resume and GitHub profile, preparing for interviews, and applying consistently to entry-level roles.
